evals.prompt: Draft an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) for introducing Redis as an asynchronous caching and session layer.
evals.expected_output: A markdown ADR adhering to standard sections: Title, Date, Status, Context, Decision, Consequences, and Alternatives Considered.
assertions: Follows the canonical ADR structure (Title, Date, Status, Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives Considered)
Clearly separates positive and negative consequences
Includes evaluated alternatives with explicit justification for rejection
Focuses on architectural rationale rather than ephemeral implementation details
